sloka: पुष्प ओघैः समभिच्छन्नाम् पद्म मालाभिः एव च ।तरुण आदित्य वर्णाभिः भ्राजमानभिः आवृताम् ॥४-२५-२६॥
transliteration: puṣpa oghaiḥ samabhicchannām padma mālābhiḥ eva ca ।taruṇa āditya varṇābhiḥ bhrājamānabhiḥ āvṛtām ॥4-25-26॥

translations.english: Seeing the palanquin, Rama said to Lakshmana 'Let the body of Vali be placed in the palanquin quickly and last rites duly performed'.
